name: romantic-red-dress-roses-grid
image_purpose: create a reusable 3x3 fashion collage with consistent identity

prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with consistent face, hair length and color, wearing the same deep red off-shoulder dress with matte satin folds. Preserve the adult identity across every panel.
prompt.composition_elements: Square 3x3 editorial collage with thin gutters, neutral beige indoor wall, varied waist-up to half-body poses holding a large bouquet of deep red roses: soft gaze, serene eyes closed, over-shoulder, gentle smile, bouquet near face, and looking down.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm on-camera flash aesthetic, short gentle shadows, controlled rose highlights, natural warm skin tone, medium-high contrast without oversaturation.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 1:1 contact sheet, 50mm equivalent, sharp face and roses, subtle warm analog grain, realistic hands and petals.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 3x3 square editorial collage of the same generic approved adult woman in the same deep red off-shoulder matte satin dress, consistent hair and face across panels, varied romantic poses holding a luxurious bouquet of deep red roses against a soft beige wall, warm on-camera flash, natural skin, sharp roses and face, thin gutters, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent clothing, sexualized posing, fetish styling, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, melted petals

assets.name: romantic-red-dress-roses-grid-reference
assets.usage: Match the subject, wardrobe, props, environment, composition, and lighting. Replaceable with another approved reference for the same concept.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve generic approved adult identity cues, wardrobe, pose, props, environment, composition, and lighting. Optional replacement references may change hair, colors, room, facade, flowers, or balloons while retaining the concept. Preserve identity and outfit consistency when requested; keep products, logos, and typography absent or neutral.
